# OneSimpleAPI

OneSimpleAPI provides utility APIs for web content, images, PDFs, QR codes, URL management, validation, exchange rates, and file management.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onesimpleapi/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Readability** (read-only): Analyze text for readability, grade level, reading time, difficult-word counts, and sentiment.
- **Calculate PPP Discount** (read-only): Calculate a purchasing-power-parity discount and localized price between an origin and a destination country.
- **Capture Screenshot**: Capture a webpage URL or raw HTML as a hosted screenshot and return its URL and rendering metadata.
- **Convert Currency** (read-only): Convert an amount between supported currencies and return the converted value and exchange rate.
- **Create Short URL**: Create a OneSimpleAPI short URL with optional one-time-use, redirect, query-forwarding, and active-date controls.
- **Delete File**: Delete a generated OneSimpleAPI file by its hosted URL and return the updated file record.
- **Expand Short URL** (read-only): Resolve a shortened URL and return its final URL, redirect count, and redirect trace.
- **Generate or Convert Color** (read-only): Generate a deterministic color palette from text or convert a supplied color into HEX, RGB, HSL, and related palette values.
- **Generate PDF**: Generate a PDF from either a webpage URL or raw HTML and return the hosted PDF URL and page metadata.
- **Generate QR Code**: Generate a hosted PNG or SVG QR code for a message and return its URL.
- **Get Image Information** (read-only): Extract dimensions, image metadata, EXIF camera fields, and available GPS details from an image URL.
- **List Files** (read-only): Return one page of generated files owned by the connected account, optionally filtered by live or deleted status.
- **List Short URLs** (read-only): Return one page of OneSimpleAPI short URLs and their click statistics.
- **Transform Image**: Resize, crop, rotate, flip, filter, border, optimize, and host an image, returning the generated image URL and metadata.
- **Validate Email** (read-only): Validate an email address and assess its domain, MX records, deliverability, disposability, role status, and registration safety.
